script.problem: It has 3 sentences. A meaning is 1 or 2 sentences.

terra.problem: “Foreskin” may be unfamiliar to a 10-year-old. Explain that it is the skin covering the tip of the penis.
“Spiritual” and “pure” may be unclear to a 10-year-old. In Deuteronomy 10:16, the picture points to turning away from stubbornness and being willing to obey God.
In Galatians 2:9, “the circumcised” refers to Jewish people as a group, not just to males who have had the procedure.
